help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to get started and where to ask questions.
help.step1_text: On the Proxies tab paste an address in any format: socks5://user:pass@host:port, http://user:pass@host:port or host:port:user:pass.
help.step2_text: Check shows latency, exit IP and country. Works for HTTP and SOCKS5.
help.step3_text: On Home choose which app uses which proxy. The "All other apps" row covers the rest of the traffic.
help.step3_text_mac: On macOS all traffic of the computer goes through the selected proxy.
help.step4_text: Press Connect on Home. Rule changes apply right away, even while connected.
help.about_text: A proxy client for the whole computer or individual apps.
help.license_line: The application code is licensed under MIT. © 2026 ProxyBridge
